decisions.reason: A polymer concrete drain housing extends the firm's core drainage engineering know-how into a related material, so it can interpret results and refine the product.
Floor-level shower drainage is the firm's core competence, so absorptive capacity is highest here and keeping the product is clearly warranted.
A designer shower drain builds directly on the firm's design-oriented drainage product families and its strategic direction.
A shower element with integrated slope fits the move toward integrated low-profile systems, though it involves somewhat newer element technology.
The backflow-protected basement drain was developed in-house, as the website states, and builds on the firm's drainage and safety expertise.
The air-admittance valve sits further from bathroom floor drainage but remains within sanitary drainage technology, giving moderate risk while still supporting a keep decision.
